verdict.rationale: Jira ships an AI layer (Rovo), so it is fair to ask whether it can consume external MCP servers as a client, and the axis applies. The pack contains no evidence of MCP client support. The official Atlassian MCP server (jira-probe-3) is the server role, which exposes Jira to other agents rather than letting Jira use external tools. Rovo's 3rd-party app connections and Marketplace integrations make no mention of plugging in MCP servers.
